attributes.description: Tier 2 detail dashboard scoped to a single Google Cloud SQL for SQL Server instance from metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*. Reached by drilling down from [GCP OTel] Cloud SQL - SQL Server Overview, which applies a database_id filter. Availability, capacity, traffic and errors, connections, locking and blocking, memory and I/O, high availability and replication. Only instances that report a SQL Server-specific metric (sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy) in the selected range are included, so MySQL and PostgreSQL instances sharing this data stream never appear.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — returns to the Cloud SQL - SQL Server overview dashboard, carrying the current time range.
Name of the SQL Server instance in focus (the part of database_id after the colon), taken from the database_id filter applied by the overview drilldown.
esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY database_id
| WHERE ss > 0
| STATS instance_id = MAX(database_id)
| EVAL instance_name = MV_LAST(SPLIT(instance_id, ":"))
| LIMIT 1
embeddableConfig.template:
{% for row in rows %}
{% if row["instance_name"].value %}{{ row["instance_name"].value }}{% else %}Cloud SQL - SQL Server instance{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"
ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens this instance's raw metric documents in Discover for the current time range, carrying the dashboard filters.

Identity and capacity of the SQL Server instance in focus: instance ID, project, region, latest Cloud SQL state, partial-uptime minutes (restarts) in the range, vCPUs, RAM and disk size, average CPU and memory utilization over the range, latest open connections, latest disk utilization and HA failover readiness. Problem values are coloured: state other than RUNNING, any partial-uptime minute, CPU or memory at 70% (amber) or 90% (red), disk at 80% (amber) or 90% (red). Only instances that report a SQL Server-specific metric (sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy) in the selected range are included, so MySQL and PostgreSQL instances sharing this data stream never appear.
esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS st = MAX(attributes.state) WHERE `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state` == 1,
        up = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)), cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)),
        memq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)), diskq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)),
        disk = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)), cpu = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`))),
        mem = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`))), conns = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)),
        r = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) WHERE `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` > 0 AND `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` < 55,
        fo = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/available_for_failover`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), instance_id = database_id, project_id, region
| STATS state = LAST(st, CASE(st IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), last_up = LAST(up, CASE(up IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_reserved_cores = LAST(cores, CASE(cores IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_memory_quota = LAST(memq, CASE(memq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_quota = LAST(diskq, CASE(diskq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_utilization = LAST(disk, CASE(disk IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        avg_cpu_utilization = AVG(cpu), avg_memory_utilization = AVG(mem),
        last_connections = LAST(conns, CASE(conns IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        restarts = COALESCE(SUM(r), 0), last_failover = LAST(fo, CASE(fo IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), ss = SUM(ss)
  BY instance_id, project_id, region
| WHERE ss > 0
| SORT avg_cpu_utilization DESC
| LIMIT 1

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS _v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/transactions/batch_request_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/transactions/batch_request_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS v = SUM(_v), mins = COUNT(*) WHERE _live > 0
| EVAL `Batch requests/s` = ROUND(v / (mins * 60.0), 2)
| KEEP `Batch requests/s`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS _v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/transactions/batch_request_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/transactions/batch_request_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS v = SUM(_v), mins = COUNT(*) WHERE _live > 0
| EVAL `Batch requests/s` = ROUND(v / (mins * 60.0), 2)
| KEEP `Batch requests/s`

embeddableConfig.description: T-SQL batches received per second over the selected range: one-minute delta counts divided by the minutes the instance was reporting, the same method as the batch requests chart. This is the instance's query throughput; compare it with its own history rather than an absolute target.
embeddableConfig.title: Batch requests/s

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Peak blocked processes` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/connections/processes_blocked`))

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Peak blocked processes` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/connections/processes_blocked`))

embeddableConfig.description: Highest number of sessions blocked at the same time in the selected range (peak of the one-minute processes_blocked gauge). Any sustained blocking turns into user-visible latency and timeouts; see Locking and blocking below for the cause. Green 0, amber 1-4, red 5 or more.
embeddableConfig.title: Peak blocked processes

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS s = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/buffer_cache_hit_ratio`)), c = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/buffer_cache_hit_ratio`))
| EVAL `Buffer cache hit %` = ROUND(s / c, 2)
| KEEP `Buffer cache hit %`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS s = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/buffer_cache_hit_ratio`)), c = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/buffer_cache_hit_ratio`))
| EVAL `Buffer cache hit %` = ROUND(s / c, 2)
| KEEP `Buffer cache hit %`

embeddableConfig.description: Average share of page lookups served from the SQL Server buffer pool without a disk read over the selected range. Healthy OLTP workloads stay above 99%; a lower ratio means the working set no longer fits in memory and reads go to disk. Red below 95%, amber 95-99%, green 99% or more.
embeddableConfig.title: Buffer cache hit %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS ple = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Page life expectancy` = LAST(ple, CASE(ple IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL))

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS ple = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Page life expectancy` = LAST(ple, CASE(ple IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL))

embeddableConfig.description: Latest page life expectancy: how many seconds a data page is expected to stay in the buffer pool without being referenced. Judge it against this instance's own baseline and memory size, not a universal constant; a sharp drop means the buffer pool is being flushed (memory pressure or a large scan) and more reads will hit disk. Not coloured because there is no universal threshold.
embeddableConfig.title: Page life expectancy

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS v = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id, attributes.state
| INLINE STATS ss_marker = SUM(ss) BY database_id
| WHERE ss_marker > 0 AND v == 1
| STATS Instances = COUNT_DISTINCT(database_id) BY tb, state = attributes.state

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS v = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id, attributes.state
| INLINE STATS ss_marker = SUM(ss) BY database_id
| WHERE ss_marker > 0 AND v == 1
| STATS Instances = COUNT_DISTINCT(database_id) BY tb, state = attributes.state

embeddableConfig.description: Cloud SQL state of the instance in each time bucket, from the one-hot instance_state metric (the state whose value is 1). A healthy instance is one solid green RUNNING band; amber is planned maintenance, red and grey mean the instance is not serving (FAILED, SUSPENDED, RUNNABLE = stopped by the owner). A bucket in which the state changed shows both states.
embeddableConfig.title: Instance state over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS u = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id
| INLINE STATS ss_marker = SUM(ss) BY database_id
| WHERE ss_marker > 0

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS u = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id
| INLINE STATS ss_marker = SUM(ss) BY database_id
| WHERE ss_marker > 0
| STATS `Uptime seconds` = MIN(u) BY tb

embeddableConfig.description: Lowest one-minute uptime sample in each time bucket. A running instance reports 60 seconds every minute; a dip below 60 marks a restart, crash, failover or stop/start in that bucket, and a gap means the instance was down or not reporting.
embeddableConfig.title: Uptime per bucket (restart detector)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS cs = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), cc = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id

| WHERE ss_marker > 0
| EVAL used = cs / cc * cores
| STATS `Cores used` = ROUND(SUM(used), 3), `Reserved cores` = ROUND(SUM(cores), 2) BY tb

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_sqlserver.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS cs = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), cc = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)), ss = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/sqlserver/memory/page_life_expectancy`)) BY tb = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), database_id

| WHERE ss_marker > 0

| STATS `Cores used` = ROUND(SUM(used), 3), `Reserved cores` = ROUND(SUM(cores), 2) BY tb

embeddableConfig.description: Average vCPUs in use (CPU utilization × reserved cores) against the reserved vCPU count in each time bucket. When the used line runs close to the reserved line for long periods the instance is CPU-bound; confirm with the CPU run queue below and resize the tier or tune the expensive queries.
embeddableConfig.title: CPU usage vs reserved cores

| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"

SQL Server holds most of its quota as buffer pool, so running close to the quota is normal; a sudden drop usually means a restart. Judge memory pressure with page life expectancy and memory grants pending rather than this line alone.
